defects.class: NULL-handling divergence from the authority (compatibility, not UB in reach)
defects.description: ossl_property_get_number_value dereferenced prop unconditionally, while the authority tests prop != NULL and answers 0 (property_query.c:51-57). A NULL definition was UB in the Rust transcription and a defined 0 in the authority. No production caller passes NULL today, and the function is currently dead code, so no observed behaviour changed.
defects.fix: Added the authority's NULL arm (return 0) and a NULL assertion to the existing focused test. The # Safety contract now reads NULL or live. No exported signature, release seam or allocator coordinate changed.

defects.class: implicit unsafe-contract obligation (borrow lifetime and alias exclusivity)
defects.description: properties<'len> returns a caller-chosen lifetime from a raw list pointer. The # Safety stated only that len must be num_properties; it did not state that the returned borrow must stay within the list allocation/lifetime or that no &mut alias to the tail may exist. The type cannot express these obligations because the owner is a raw pointer.
defects.fix: The # Safety contract now names both obligations and the function gained a one-line description. Documentation-only; no code or signature change, and no SAFETY_DISCHARGED claim is made for the raw-pointer boundary.
